children: Australian shares were likely to open flat on Wednesday, as steady copper prices were expected to lift commodity stocks but rising local bond yields and a second straight monthly fall in consumer sentiment kept investors cautious.
The local share price index futures (YAPcm1) were largely flat, a 28.3-point premium to the underlying S&P/ASX 200 index
close. The benchmark rose 0.6% on Tuesday.
